target: Inventory sync v3 — Activity · Sync · Stores (Ignat's sketches)
primary_task: A Synder user with Shopify and QuickBooks connects their Shopify stores to Inventory Sync, fixes what each store still needs, turns sync on, and later checks activity and stock differences.
observations: Help "?" icons carry only a title tooltip: []
Dark top bar = prototype switcher (Layout, State), not product UI. Sample data throughout.
Material icon names (help, build, check_circle, chevron_right, open_in_new, schedule) in state text are icon glyphs, not visible words.

Agreed with Ignat: no Check again — the product detects the setting automatically; in the prototype Open Settings sets it at once. Location is never preselected. Stock differences are not shown on store cards.
